Both pathways converge on IMD1, indicating a possible dual mechanism of action. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The presence of two distinct but converging targets implies that cis-Isopinocamphone may exert its effects through different molecular mechanisms, potentially involving distinct pathways that ultimately lead to the inhibition of IMD1. This integrated evidence supports the hypothesis that cis-Isopinocamphone could act as a modulator of IMD1, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the specific mechanism and therapeutic relevance.
